text_block_list.text: (Vrrrroooom...)

—Inside the bus heading toward summer 
training camp.

This training camp seems crucial for 
Manhattan Cafe as well with the Japan Cup 
coming up, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Leckermaul"...
choice_data_list: Did those words catch your attention?
Did those words catch your attention?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, I just couldn't help but remember.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Saying it aloud... makes my heart feel 
restless... Leckermäulchen..."

An Umamusume sitting nearby happened to 
strike up a conversation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Did you just say... "Leckermaul"? Do you 
like German folklore?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Folklore...? No... Not 
particularly...

The one who called out to me was Eishin 
Flash, an Umamusume from Germany.

Judging by the way she spoke... is 
"Leckermäulchen" some sort of German term?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is "Leckermaul" a German word?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a person's name.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Leckermaul" comes from a German folktale—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is the name of a "Witch."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A witch...

A rather concerning topic came up. Turning 
to look at Agnes Tachyon sitting right 
beside me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, ah... I heard you, but whether it 
actually sank in... who knows...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, I'm going to tell 
Trainer and Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This summer, I will— sever all ties with 
you."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have a little something to do myself. 
It's practically meaningless, but even 
so... I simply must...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, just pretend I'm not here and 
enjoy yourselves, you two.

The bus rolls onward, carrying everyone's 
thoughts and ambitions. No one knows what 
awaits them at the training camp.
